title: ProviderSwitch
responsibility: Wraps provider-switch records in switches and delegates queries and mutations to a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.session
inputs.description: Session key stored in the switches session column, which is the table's primary key and identifies one provider-switch record. The model neither generates nor validates it; the services call validateSessionId, which accepts 1 to 128 characters that start with a letter or digit and continue with letters, digits, _ or -.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.id
inputs.description: Switch revision stored in the switches id column; ProviderSwitchRepository writes it as the request UUID, a colon and the status. It is not the primary key, and the model passes it to the adapter exactly as given without generating or checking it.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.data
inputs.description: SwitchRequest payload with id, sessionId, target, status, createdAt and reason, which the SQLite adapter stores as JSON text and parses on read. The model passes it by reference inside a shallow copy of the input and never reads or validates its fields.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.find
outputs.description: Resolves with the switches row the adapter returns for the id, an object with session, id and data, or null when the adapter returns none. The model returns the adapter's promise itself, so the resolved value is unchanged.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous exceptions and promise rejections from the adapter reach the caller unchanged, because the model has no try/catch. For findBy, create and update, a throwing getter on the fields or input object also propagates, because that object is spread before the adapter is called.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown synchronously when a static method is called without ProviderSwitch as its receiver or with a null or undefined adapter, because reading this.definition.table or an adapter method fails on a missing value. The class contains no throw statement.
